title: aaj roze aza hai wawaila
body:
aaj roze aza hai wawaila
sheh ka matam bapa hai wawaila
zehr dekar ali naqi ko laee'n
dil me qush ho raha hai wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar se bulwaake sheh ko zalim ne
qatl na haq kiya hai wawaila
haaye pardes me musafir par
zulm kaisa hua hai wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
bepidar hogaye pisar sheh ke
sab ko sadma hua hai wawaila
sar se bewa ke aur yateemou ke
sheh ka saya utha hai wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj daswa imam dunya se
aye *hussaini* utha hai wawaila
